steps.code:
# Get release dates for the 12 songs that need them
# First, identify which songs have TODO in the note
import re

# Parse note content lines
lines = note_content['content'].split('\n')
todo_songs = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title (between "- " and " BY ")
        match = re.search(r'- (.+?) BY ', line)
        if match:
            todo_songs.append(match.group(1))

print("Songs needing release month:", todo_songs)

# Map song titles to song_ids from liked_songs
title_to_id = {song['title']: song['song_id'] for song in liked_songs}
print("Title to ID mapping:", title_to_id)

# Get release dates for these songs
release_dates = {}
for title in todo_songs:
    song_id = title_to_id.get(title)
    if song_id is not None:
        song_info = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=song_id)
        print(f"Song {title} (id={song_id}): {song_info}")
        # Extract release_date and format as MM/YYYY
        if 'release_date' in song_info:
            release_date = song_info['release_date']
            # Parse date string (e.g., "2019-01-01T00:00:00")
            from datetime import datetime
            dt = datetime.fromisoformat(release_date)
            release_dates[title] = dt.strftime('%m/%Y')
        else:
            print(f"Error: no release_date for {title}")
    else:
        print(f"Warning: no song_id found for {title}")

print("Release dates:", release_dates)

steps.code:
# Build the updated note content by replacing TODO with release months
new_lines = []
for line in note_content['content'].split('\n'):
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title
        match = re.search(r'- (.+?) BY ', line)
        if match:
            title = match.group(1)
            if title in release_dates:
                # Replace TODO with the release month
                line = line.replace('RELEASED_AT TODO', f"RELEASED_AT {release_dates[title]}")
    new_lines.append(line)

new_content = '\n'.join(new_lines)
print(new_content)
